pirs.title: Legislative Tracking
pirs.question: What committee reports are advancing to plenary, and what legislative change do they propose?
pirs.answer_summary: HD01KU35 (KU) advances Proposition 2025/26:164 unanimously — amends Kommunallagen for digital meeting chairperson verification and private operator annual oversight reporting; effective 1 July 2026

pirs.title: Voting Patterns
pirs.question: Were there party divisions or reservations in committee?
pirs.answer_summary: Unanimous all-party support in KU (all 8 parties). No reservations filed. No votes yet in plenary — expected week of 2026-05-18

pirs.title: Welfare State / Fraud Prevention
pirs.question: What committee actions address welfare fraud or social service accountability?
pirs.answer_summary: KU35 Track 2 establishes first systematic municipal oversight reporting chain for private welfare operators; annual board-to-council reporting mandated; directly addresses välfärdsbrott (welfare fraud)

pirs.title: Election 2026 Significance
pirs.question: How do this week's committee reports affect election 2026 party positioning?
pirs.answer_summary: KU35 is pre-election politically neutral; no party gains asymmetric advantage at plenary; long-term election salience depends on what annual welfare fraud reports reveal; SD may benefit from welfare fraud framing if reports are damaging

pirs.title: Local Democracy
pirs.question: What legislative developments affect local government structure and democratic participation?
pirs.answer_summary: KU35 Track 1 directly improves local democracy by clarifying remote participation standards; ~7,700 elected municipal officials benefit from clearer legal framework; rural representation strengthened
